title: Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO Details
intro:
Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO is a book build issue of ₹39.04 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.20 crore shares aggregating to ₹31.63 crores and offer for sale of 0.05 crore shares aggregating to ₹7.41 crores.

Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO bidding opened for subscription on Jul 31, 2026 and will close on Aug 4, 2026. The allotment for the Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 5, 2026. Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 7, 2026.

Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO is set issue price band at ₹151 to ₹159 per share. The lot size for an application is 800 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,54,400 (1,600 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹3,81,600.

Narnolia Financial Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is PUNE E-STOCK BROKING Ltd.

Refer to Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2016, Fusion Klassroom Edutech Ltd. is an education technology company focused on providing professional and competitive examination coaching through digital and hybrid learning models across multiple cities. The company offers coaching programs for courses such as CA, CS, CMA, and other commerce-related examinations. It combines classroom teaching with online platforms to enhance accessibility and learning flexibility.

The company operates a proprietary AI-powered Education OTT platform offering live and recorded learning through Klassroom Konnect, serving millions of learners with over 100,000 app downloads. Its growth depends on student enrollments, faculty strength, course quality, and increasing demand for professional certification programs.

Incorporated in 2016, Fusion Klassroom Edutech Ltd. is an education technology company focused on providing professional and competitive examination coaching through digital and hybrid learning models across multiple cities. The company offers coaching programs for courses such as CA, CS, CMA, and other commerce-related examinations. It combines classroom teaching with online platforms to enhance accessibility and learning flexibility. Business Model B2C – Education OTT & Offline Learning Klassroom operates a subscription-based Education OTT platform offering academic, competitive exam, and skill-development courses. Pricing is affordable at ₹1,250 per year (basic) and ₹3,000 per year (enterprise). Additionally, 30 partner centres in Mumbai provide offline coaching for Classes 8–12, JEE, NEET, CA, and skill development programs, with annual fees ranging between ₹25,000–₹45,000. Skill Development & Employability Programs The Company offers vocational and emerging technology courses including AI, machine learning, data science, coding, and entrepreneurship. These programs focus on enhancing employability and practical skills through structured classroom and hybrid learning formats. B2B2C, B2B & B2G Institutional Partnerships Klassroom collaborates with state governments, private institutions, universities, and corporations to deliver large-scale academic and skilling programs. Services include digital content deployment, teacher training, AI-ML labs, hybrid learning models, internship modules, and AI-powered performance evaluation systems. The company operates a proprietary AI-powered Education OTT platform offering live and recorded learning through Klassroom Konnect, serving millions of learners with over 100,000 app downloads. Fusion Klassroom Edutech Ltd aims to expand its presence through technology-driven education solutions. Its growth depends on student enrollments, faculty strength, course quality, and increasing demand for professional certification programs. As of July 22, 26, the company had a total workforce of 26 personnel. faqs.question: How to apply in Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Fusion Klassroom Edutech IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
